b-field-wire.name: Magnetic Field of a Straight Wire
b-field-wire.intro: Compute the magnetic field around a long straight wire from the current and distance to the wire using Ampère's law, B = μ₀·I/(2πr).

capacitance-parallel-plate.name: Parallel-Plate Capacitance
capacitance-parallel-plate.intro: Find the capacitance of a parallel-plate capacitor from the relative permittivity, plate area, and separation using C = ε₀·εr·A/d.

capacitive-reactance.name: Capacitive Reactance
capacitive-reactance.intro: Calculate the capacitive reactance from capacitance and frequency using X_C = 1/(2π·f·C) for AC circuit analysis.

capacitors-parallel.name: Capacitors in Parallel
capacitors-parallel.intro: Add multiple capacitances (μF/pF) to get the equivalent parallel capacitance C_eq = C₁ + C₂ + … and note that the voltage rating is the minimum.

capacitors-series.name: Capacitors in Series
capacitors-series.intro: Combine multiple capacitances in series using 1/C_eq = 1/C₁ + 1/C₂ + …; total capacitance drops and the voltage rating rises.

coil-torque.name: Coil Torque in a Magnetic Field
coil-torque.intro: Compute the magnetic torque on a current-carrying coil from turns N, current I, area A, field B, and angle θ as τ = N·I·A·B·sinθ.

current-density.name: Current Density
current-density.intro: Calculate the current density from current I and conductor cross-sectional area A using J = I/A for ampacity evaluation.

drift-velocity.name: Electron Drift Velocity
drift-velocity.intro: Find the drift velocity of charge carriers from current, carrier density, area, and elementary charge using v_d = I/(n·A·e).

electric-potential-point.name: Electric Potential of a Point Charge
electric-potential-point.intro: Compute the electric potential at a point from a point charge q at distance r using V = k·q/r (k is Coulomb's constant).

electric-power.name: Electric Power
electric-power.intro: Calculate DC electric power from voltage and current (or resistance) using P = V·I = V²/R = I²·R, with any form solvable.

energy-capacitor.name: Energy Stored in a Capacitor
energy-capacitor.intro: Compute the energy stored in a capacitor's electric field from capacitance C and voltage V using E = ½·C·V².

energy-inductor.name: Energy Stored in an Inductor
energy-inductor.intro: Compute the magnetic energy stored in an inductor from inductance L and current I using E = ½·L·I².

faraday-induction.name: Faraday's Law of Induction
faraday-induction.intro: Compute the induced electromotive force from turns N, flux change ΔΦ, and time interval Δt as ε = N·|ΔΦ|/Δt.

force-wire-field.name: Magnetic Force on a Current-Carrying Wire
force-wire-field.intro: Compute the magnetic force on a current-carrying wire from field B, current I, length L, and angle θ using F = B·I·L·sinθ.

free-space-impedance.name: Free-Space Impedance
free-space-impedance.intro: Compute the intrinsic impedance of free space Z₀ = √(μ₀/ε₀) ≈ 376.73 Ω for antenna matching and wave propagation.

inductance-solenoid.name: Solenoid Inductance
inductance-solenoid.intro: Compute the inductance of a solenoid from turns, cross-sectional area, and length using L = μ₀·N²·A/l.

inductors-parallel.name: Inductors in Parallel
inductors-parallel.intro: Find the equivalent parallel inductance from 1/L_eq = 1/L₁ + 1/L₂ + …; total inductance decreases.

inductors-series.name: Inductors in Series
inductors-series.intro: Find the equivalent series inductance (neglecting mutual inductance) as L_eq = L₁ + L₂ + … for coil combinations.

lc-resonance.name: LC Resonance Frequency
lc-resonance.intro: Compute the natural resonant frequency of an undamped LC circuit from L and C using f = 1/(2π√(L·C)).

magnetic-flux.name: Magnetic Flux
magnetic-flux.intro: Compute the magnetic flux through a loop from field B, perpendicular area A, and angle θ using Φ = B·A·cosθ.

ohms-law.name: Ohm's Law
ohms-law.intro: Compute any one of voltage, current, and resistance from the other two using V = I·R — the foundational relation for circuit analysis.

resistivity-law.name: Resistance from Resistivity
resistivity-law.intro: Compute a conductor's resistance from resistivity, length, and cross-sectional area using R = ρ·L/A for material and wire selection.

resistors-parallel.name: Resistors in Parallel
resistors-parallel.intro: Find the equivalent parallel resistance from 1/R_eq = 1/R₁ + 1/R₂ + …; total resistance is below the smallest branch.

resistors-series.name: Resistors in Series
resistors-series.intro: Find the equivalent series resistance as R_eq = R₁ + R₂ + … for voltage-divider and higher-resistance combinations.

rl-time-constant.name: RL Time Constant
rl-time-constant.intro: Compute the RL time constant from inductance L and resistance R using τ = L/R for transient-circuit analysis.

solenoid-field.name: Magnetic Field of a Solenoid
solenoid-field.intro: Compute the magnetic field inside a long solenoid from turns per unit length n and current I using B = μ₀·n·I for electromagnet and coil design.

coulomb-force.name: Coulomb's Force
coulomb-force.intro: Compute the electrostatic force between two point charges using Coulomb's law, F = k·q₁·q₂/r². (Owned by the science category.)

electric-field-point.name: Electric Field of a Point Charge
electric-field-point.intro: Compute the electric field of a point charge from E = k·q/r². (Owned by the science category.)
